criterion_bindings.exemption: The historical-tier join remains deferred under CD-0217. Existing watermark evidence is TestRebuildKnowledgeIndexAndQ9Q10UseCurrentGitHead in internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go; no executed prune mechanism is asserted.

Retirement eligibility is an operation property, not a PM1 query-corpus case. TestResearchRetirementTerminalOwnersEligible in internal/store/research_retirement_test.go is a candidate anchor; integrated coverage remains unmeasured under CON-816.

Publication separation and optional-pin protection require operation witnesses. TestResearchRetirementActivePinsProtectAndTerminalReleaseFences in internal/store/research_retirement_test.go is a candidate anchor; publication coverage remains unmeasured under CON-816.

Historical derivation is a rebuild property, covered by TestCompactionPayloadRequiresExplicitUniqueScopeArrays and TestUpcastCompactionLinkPublishedV1PreservesLegacyBytesAndOrder in internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go.

Dry-run write absence is an operation property. TestResearchRetirementDryRunMixedBatchHasNoWrites in internal/store/research_retirement_test.go is a candidate anchor; integrated coverage remains unmeasured under CON-816.

Restart and committed replay are operation properties. TestResearchRetireDryRunAndReplay in internal/agent/research_surface_test.go is a candidate replay anchor; restart coverage remains unmeasured under CON-816.

summary: Complete PM7 successor preserving deferred terminal work pruning, Git and event authority, canonical locator proof, historical front matter and frozen Domain scope, live/historical query composition, immutable pruned identities and PM10 separation. Replaces archive-driven research cleanup with reusable read-only terminal packs and explicit bounded idempotent retirement of terminal-owner packs with zero active required or optional pins, without calendar expiration. Live cutover and integrated conformance remain deployment obligations.
title: Compaction retention and historical index
